events.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do first?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you start by sorting the donated items and setting aside anything that’s too worn to use? I’ll swing back once I’ve got the pickup list.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll sort the donated items now and set aside anything too worn to use.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times if that makes the repair drive easier.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Faye — thank you. I’ll note your help around pickup and drop-off so we can make the repair drive as smooth as possible.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the pickup and drop-off windows, and I’ll work around them.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the fence panels and mailbox at the top of the list. If you spot anything else urgent, just let me know and I’ll add it.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I spot anything else urgent.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate that. I’ll keep the list moving and make sure the urgent fixes stay first.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Mara: I’m on it—I’ll sort the donated items now and set aside anything too worn to use.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — that’s a big help. Let me know if you want me to label boxes or move anything once you’re done.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you label the boxes when I’m done sorting? I’ll let you know as soon as I’m ready for help moving anything.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still happening, just moved to Sunday at the community center. If you spot any urgent fixes, send them my way and I’ll keep them at the top.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I spot anything urgent.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate that. I’ll keep the list moving and make sure the urgent fixes stay first.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Noah: I’m a bit out of the loop, but I can ask around and see what tools or supplies folks can spare for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Noah — thank you. If you can check on tools and supplies, I’ll keep the list updated and tell you what we still need.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll ask around and bring you any updates I can find.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Mara. Let’s check in after lunch and make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mara: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll check back after lunch and keep things moving.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Eli: Perfect — after lunch we’ll do a quick check and finish any last bits for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll wait to label the boxes, and I’m ready when you need help moving them.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — I’m sorting through the donations now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I’m ready for you to help move the boxes.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be here when you’re ready.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Nell: Not yet—I’m still waiting on the official update, but I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything new.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. Keep me posted, and I’ll stay ready to help once the update comes in.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll ask around and share anything I hear.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’m ready to help, so just point me to the first task for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Tess: Great — I’ll check what’s still needed and send you straight to the first open task.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when you send it over, and I’ll jump on the first open task for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Mara
